updates.title: Buddy grows with you
updates.description: StudyHub Buddy's sprout now grows from your completed topics — a second leaf at 10, a bud at 25 and a flower at 50 — and Buddy has become springier: its leaf and arms swing and settle as it moves, it crouches before hopping and bounces after hard landings, and you can pick it up and throw it (or use Toss Buddy in its settings). It may grab the sidebar edge on the way down, follows your mouse with its eyes, has new faces and small idle habits, yawns before napping, and in Quiet mode its leaf droops until you answer a question right.

updates.title: Meet StudyHub Buddy
updates.description: A small optional companion now lives at the edges of the page: it walks along the bottom, climbs the sidebar — and tumbles off when you collapse it — offers optional quiz questions from topics you have studied, shares one of 68 short facts (including 24 on computer science) and cheers when you finish a topic, while staying off your content; turn it off or change its colour, eyes, accessory, movement, quiz frequency and personality under ⋮ → StudyHub Buddy.

updates.title: Claude Code Mastery
updates.description: 68 topics in 14 modules — foundations and the six permission modes, context and sessions, CLAUDE.md and memory, permissions and safety, hooks, MCP, skills, subagents and agent teams, Git and GitHub workflows, automation and CI/CD, debugging and verification, and advanced workflows — built around a Spring Boot sample project, with 16 hands-on labs, a capstone with a grading rubric, 11 simulations and visualizers, 11 checks, 7 comparisons, 10 flashcard decks, Revision, Cheat Sheets, Quick Revision and a new Claude Code Mastery study plan.

updates.title: Knowledge galaxy
updates.description: The dashboard knowledge map is now a galaxy: each library group in the sidebar is a sun and its 11 subjects are planets orbiting it, with a ring that fills as you complete topics and your progress written under every name. Select a planet to fly to it and see your next topic, or a sun to zoom into its system; it now works on phones and tablets too, with touch, and "View in knowledge map" in search still takes you straight to a subject.

updates.title: Choose what to back up and restore
updates.description: Progress Import / Export now lets you tick which of the 7 categories — progress, bookmarks, history, question results, study plans, notes and checklists — to export, and which categories in a backup to restore, with a review of what each one replaces; anything you leave unticked stays exactly as it is, and older backups still work.

updates.title: DevOps & Deployment
updates.description: 42 topics in 9 modules — DevOps foundations, Linux for deployment, Docker, Dockerfiles, networking, PostgreSQL volumes, Compose, configuration and secrets, VPS deployment, Nginx, HTTPS, GitHub Actions CI/CD, registries, monitoring and security — with 18 hands-on labs, a capstone Spring Boot + PostgreSQL deployment project, 11 simulations, visualizers and tools (including an interactive deployment checklist), 12 checks, comparisons and flashcard decks, Revision, Cheat Sheets, Quick Revision and a new DevOps & Deployment study plan.

updates.title: My notes
updates.description: Take Markdown notes on any topic with Add note, or import a .md file; each note is linked to its subject, module and topic, and My notes lets you search, filter by subject, module, topic or date, sort, download notes as .md files and jump back to the topic. Notes stay in this browser and travel with Progress Import / Export.

updates.title: Study plans
updates.description: 13 built-in study plans in 35 Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced variants, plus a custom plan builder for any subjects, modules or topics, with day-by-day schedules that count the progress you already have and question sessions filtered by difficulty.

updates.title: Operating Systems
updates.description: 38 topics in 7 modules — OS fundamentals, processes and threads, CPU scheduling, synchronization, deadlocks and the Banker's algorithm, memory management, storage and I/O — with 5 simulators and visualizers, 2 checks, a flashcard deck, Revision, Quick Revision and a 15-minute emergency sheet.

updates.title: System Design
updates.description: 82 topics in 11 modules — from requirements and estimation to caching, replication, sharding, CAP, reliability, messaging and four case studies — with 23 interactive simulations, 22 checks, comparisons and flashcard decks, an interview simulator, Revision and Quick Revision.

updates.title: Clearer navigation and six themes
updates.description: A grouped, collapsible sidebar, one header menu, six colour themes, search results grouped by type, and this What's new panel.

updates.title: Excel Fundamentals
updates.description: 18 Excel topics in Computer Science Concepts with 4 interactive exercises, including a PivotTable builder, plus complete, quick and 10-minute revision sheets.

updates.title: Computer Networks
updates.description: 88 topics in 22 modules with 15 interactive simulators and calculators, Revision and Quick Revision.

updates.title: Knowledge map focus
updates.description: Select a subject on the dashboard map to focus it and see its progress. Subject search results can open the subject on the map.

updates.title: Linux
updates.description: 59 topics in 18 modules with 12 interactive exercises, Revision and Quick Revision.

updates.title: Interactive exercises and study sessions

updates.title: DBMS and PostgreSQL
updates.description: 75 topics in 26 modules, from SQL fundamentals to transactions, MVCC, indexing and query optimization, with Revision and Quick Revision.

updates.title: Spring Boot
updates.description: 91 topics in 15 modules with Revision and Quick Revision.

updates.title: Object-Oriented Programming
updates.description: 75 topics in 11 modules with Revision and Quick Revision.

updates.title: Data Structures & Algorithms
updates.description: 113 topics in 6 modules with Revision and Quick Revision.

updates.title: Aptitude
